technical.summary: BRK-B shows strong uptrend structure with price above all major moving averages and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88/84, Stoch 91) combined with declining volume and no fresh crossover signals suggest limited upside room and elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, or retail channels; earnings in 36 days presents timing risk with minimal conviction support.

sentiment.summary: No congressional activity; Fear index (42) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (403.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, strong dollar headwind, and elevated credit stress create highly unfavourable conditions for equities despite 36-day earnings buffer.
